headline: Alphabet loses about $500bn in market value after weak Q3 profit
summary: Alphabet's stock tumbled, erasing roughly $500bn in market value, after Q3 net profit fell 25% year-over-year to $26.2bn, missing expectations, even as revenue rose to $127.6bn. Google said its AI search products are generating less revenue and it plans to offset that with more ads. Coverage varies in emphasis, from Google's fix-it framing to investor alarm that sent shares to a six-month low.
